name: mathocr
title: MathOCR
description: Multi-engine screen OCR with LaTeX output for math. Fork of ScreenOCR.
author: emirbartu

preferences.name: ocrMode
preferences.title: Recognition Level
preferences.description: Affects performance and accuracy of the text recognition

preferences.name: languageCorrection
preferences.title: Options
preferences.description: Disabling this property returns the raw recognition results, which provides performance benefits but less accurate results
preferences.label: Use language correction

preferences.name: playSound
preferences.description: Play camera shutter sound when capturing screenshots
preferences.label: Play sounds

preferences.name: showToast
preferences.description: Show toast notifications for command results
preferences.label: Show toast messages

preferences.name: keepImage
preferences.description: Keep the image in the clipboard after text recognition
preferences.label: Keep image in clipboard

preferences.name: customWordsList
preferences.title: Custom Words List
preferences.description: You can improve text recognition by providing a list of words that are special to your text
preferences.label: Custom Words List

preferences.name: ocrEngine
preferences.title: OCR Engine
preferences.description: Choose the OCR engine. VisionKit is built-in. CLIs need separate install. Ollama engines need locally running server.

preferences.name: ollamaEndpoint
preferences.title: Ollama Endpoint
preferences.description: URL of the Ollama server. Used only when Ollama engines are selected. Default: http://localhost:11434

preferences.name: tesseractLanguages
preferences.title: Tesseract Languages
preferences.description: Language codes for Tesseract OCR (e.g., 'eng', 'eng+fra+deu'). Used only when Tesseract engine is selected.

commands.title: Select Recognition Languages
commands.description: Choose which languages will be used for text recognition
commands.name: preferences
recognize-text
commands.title: Recognize Text
commands.description: Detect all text from the captured screen area

commands.name: recognize-text-fullscreen
commands.title: Recognize Text on Entire Screen
commands.description: Detect all text from the captured screen

commands.name: recognize-text-math
commands.title: Recognize Math
commands.description: Detect math equations and LaTeX from the captured screen area

commands.name: recognize-text-math-fullscreen
commands.title: Recognize Math on Entire Screen
commands.description: Detect math equations and LaTeX from the entire screen

commands.name: detect-barcode
commands.title: Detect Barcode/QR Code
commands.description: Detect barcodes and QR codes from the captured screen area
